services.desc: Gilbert gravel bar to Tyler Bend pavilion person shuttle - $40 per person. 9am, 10am, 11am. For additional times please call to check on availability. One person - No coolers, gear, dogs, vessels, etc. 1. Reserve and pay for shuttle 2. Drop off your vessels, gear, coolers, people, dogs, etc. at Tyler Bend 3. Drive your vehicle to Gilbert gravel bar and park. 4. Meet our driver at the NPS vault toilet/dumpster area at your scheduled time for shuttle back to Tyler Bend pavilion parking lot. We will be in a white ford van. If we are sold out please call, we may have an additional vehicle
